tasks.heading: #IMB-TK-20 - Trips stuck on the broker's screen after being moved to a different provider

items.text: Two trips for rider Robert Fall (booked by the SanFran broker for Friday 09-05) were first handed to provider TransMetro. The broker then pulled them back and, the next day, handed them instead to Centurion Medical Transport.

The pull-back from TransMetro was only half completed. Our system cancelled the trips at TransMetro correctly, but never recorded on its own side that the cancellation was done - so it kept thinking a cancellation was still pending with TransMetro.
Because of that unfinished bookkeeping, the system refused to send the trips onward to Centurion.
